source_claims.quote: Pegasus (or Pegasos) is a winged-horse from Greek mythology which was fathered by Poseidon and was born from the severed neck of the gorgon Medusa, slain by Perseus.

statement.id: Pegasus adalah kuda bersayap mitologi Yunani, putra Poseidon yang muncul ketika Perseus memenggal Medusa.
statement.en: Pegasus is a winged horse of Greek mythology, fathered by Poseidon and born when Perseus beheaded Medusa.

source_claims.quote: PEGASOS (Pegasus) was an immortal, winged horse which sprang from the neck of the beheaded Gorgon Medousa (Medusa).

statement.id: Pegasus adalah kuda bersayap abadi yang muncul dari leher Medusa.
statement.en: Pegasus is an immortal winged horse that emerged from Medusa's neck.

source_claims.quote: Pegasus lastly was also regarded as the horse of the Muses, and in this capacity he is more celebrated in modern times than he ever was in antiquity ; for with the ancients he had no connection with the Muses, except that by his hoof he called forth the inspiring well Hippocrene.

statement.id: Pegasus belakangan juga dianggap kuda para Muse; dalam peran ini ia lebih terkenal di zaman modern daripada di masa kuno, sebab bagi orang kuno hubungannya dengan para Muse hanya lewat hentakan kukunya yang memunculkan mata air Hippocrene.
statement.en: Pegasus was also later regarded as the horse of the Muses; in this role he is more celebrated in modern times than in antiquity, since for the ancients his only link to the Muses was that his hoof called forth the Hippocrene well.

source_claims.quote: When the Mousai (Muses) sang, heaven, the stars, the sea and rivers stood still, while Mount Helikon (Helicon), beguiled by the pleasure of it all, swelled skyward till, by the will of Poseidon, Pegasos checked it by striking the summit with his hoof.
source_claims.locator: Classical literature quotes: Pegasus & the Spring of Hippocrene

statement.id: Antoninus Liberalis: Gunung Helikon, terpikat kenikmatan nyanyian para Muse, membengkak ke langit sampai Pegasos, atas kehendak Poseidon, menghentikannya dengan menghentak puncaknya.
statement.en: Antoninus Liberalis: Mount Helikon, beguiled by the pleasure of the Muses' song, swelled skyward until Pegasos, by Poseidon's will, checked it by striking the summit with his hoof.

source_claims.quote: It was made, they say, by [Pegasos] the horse of Bellerophon striking the ground with this hoof.
source_claims.locator: Classical literature quotes: Pegasus & the Spring of Hippocrene

statement.id: Pausanias: Hippokrene, kata orang, dibuat oleh Pegasos, kuda Bellerophon, yang menghentak tanah dengan kukunya.
statement.en: Pausanias: Hippokrene was made, they say, by Pegasos, the horse of Bellerophon, striking the ground with his hoof.
